# Pixelfork SFX Library
> Game sound effects for AI-generated web games. No install: 2 lines, then SFX.play('coin.collect').

- AI guide (start here): https://advme.github.io/pixelfork-sfx-library/AI-GUIDE.md
- Add to a game: <script src="https://advme.github.io/pixelfork-sfx-library/dist/sfx.js"></script> then SFX.load('casual'); SFX.attach();
- Every sound, machine-readable: https://advme.github.io/pixelfork-sfx-library/dist/casual.json
- Pairs with the Super Casual UI Kit: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/pixelfork-v1/mobile-game-ui-library@v0.44.1-A/AI-GUIDE.md
